title: Coordinate + assembly gate checklist (assembly recorded, 0/1-based, liftOver provenance)
context: Coordinate off-by-one errors and wrong-assembly tracks are the classic silent failures of genomics — a track can appear to load while pointing to completely wrong loci. genome-browser-tracks treats coordinate/assembly correctness as a non-skippable, auditable blocking gate applied to every pack. This task produces the gate checklist as a committed artifact, separate from the license gate because coordinate errors and licensing violations are distinct failure classes requiring different expertise.
objective: Create the coordinate + assembly gate checklist that every pack must pass, encoding the required assembly recording, coordinate-convention normalisation, format validation, and liftOver provenance requirements, and producing a committed PASS/FAIL artifact per pack.
acceptanceCriteria: Requires the assembly to be recorded (hg38 primary / hg19 secondary) and the source coordinate convention (0-based half-open vs 1-based) captured and correctly normalised.
Requires validateFiles/format validation to pass and an assembly-mismatch sanity check (e.g. chromosomes on hg38 vs hg19).
When liftOver is used, requires recorded chain provenance (chain file source + version + URL) and a mapped/unmapped count report committed as part of the pack.
Produces a committed PASS/FAIL artifact per pack recording which checks ran and the outcomes, signed off by the Bioinformatics reviewer.
Document output licensed CC-BY-4.0; commit is DCO signed-off.
resources: PLAN.md §6 (Solution approach — pipeline step 3 and step 6)
output: review/coordgate-003-checklist.md — committed coordinate + assembly gate checklist and per-pack PASS/FAIL artifact template, ready for use by every pack task.
